comments: 80293f67: If the X-Ref indicating cross-references is defined, go to the X-Ref logic in the ^DIE17 routine.
4ab29f98: If no X-Ref is defined, set X to '?BAD' to indicate a bad cross-reference.
e54c79dc: Quit the current code and jump to the QQ^DIEQ routine to handle post-action data transformations. DZ is a placeholder variable for any data transformations needed before QQ^DIEQ.

dc53515f: Store field information in the DQ array for use in other DIE routines. D is the internal field number, DLB is the field label, DV is the fieldtype, DU is the input transform, DW is the multiple type, and the code section after the @ pulls in any X, X1, etc. routine specific to the field.

b0b3e6be: If a computed code (DE) is not defined, perform field audit code (O), then branch based on X: RD for '_reference_', A for value pointer fields ('file@(.01)'), or X for word-processing fields '@'.
9e2d61fc: Set DG to the data type from DV and retrieve any computed code (DE) and input transform (DU) specific to the field.

a24e94f1: If DG indicates a pointer to a file entry (DG['P') and the pointed-to file has data, resolve the pointer value (.01 field of pointed-to file's 0 node) and data type (2nd piece of 0 node). Also check for a DINUM in the DD.
46f13a15: If DG indicates a Vale-only pointer (DG['V') and the pointer file has data, resolve the pointer value and data type. Also check if a DINUM is defined.
8fa5250c: If DG indicates a DINUM is present, execute the DINUM logic in ^DD('DD'). If a 'S' code is present, see if any additional logic is required based on theece after the colon.
be1166d5: If no data was retrieved into X, put the computed expression back into X. Then branch based on the valType: N if not a value pointer, A if valoptr with no X-ref logic, or back to N^DIE17.
3c4587cd: If the valType doesn't indicate an audit trail or #-delimited word processing field, branch to RD.
4962ddcd: Execute field audit processing in E^DIE0, then branch back to RD if data is in X or to PR if not.
37abd7f4: Set the routine name to DGJXE9 and the field sequence number to 1.
2ceb9bee: Set initial values for the DATE DICTATED field (10.01) - DW is the multiple type (DT=Date/Time), DV is the MUMPS datatype (DX=Date), DU is null, and DLB is the field label.
7f1f87e6: Branch to the field executable code labeled RE.

77dac7ef: Set the default date/time behavior to the current date/time, execute ^%DT to convert to FileMan internal format, then optionally strip the time value if the result is less than 1 (when time is not applicable).

c3351154: If an input transform is defined (DG>9), perform transform audit (F^DIE17) and retrieve any computed code (DE). Set DQ=2 and execute the X2 label code. If data is present, set X and attempt to stuff the value, else branch to A.
ded28fe2: For a NULL input value, clear all word-processing root (DT multiple) node values for the entry.
